STORY-FEAT4-047.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema Contract
STORY-FEAT4-047.description: Formalize the provider detail response schema including NPI data, address, taxonomy, and enriched external links to ensure consistent downstream consumption by chat and evaluation flows.

STORY-FEAT4-048.title: Implement External Link Enrichment Logic
STORY-FEAT4-048.description: Extend provider_detail_service to construct and attach external links including state medical board lookup URLs and research site references based on provider state and identifiers.

STORY-FEAT4-049.title: Add URL Validation for External Links
STORY-FEAT4-049.description: Integrate url_guardian to validate and sanitize all generated external links before returning provider details, ensuring safe and reliable URLs in responses.

STORY-FEAT4-050.title: Handle NPI Registry Edge Cases and Fallbacks
STORY-FEAT4-050.description: Enhance service to gracefully handle edge cases including multiple results, inactive NPIs, missing fields, and API timeouts with structured fallback responses.

STORY-FEAT4-051.title: Integration Test for External Link Validation Flow
STORY-FEAT4-051.description: Create integration tests verifying that provider detail responses include validated, reachable, and properly formatted external links after passing through url_guardian and service layers.
